claims.statement: For a rank-one plus two rank-two Parseval frame decomposition lambda vv^T+S1+S2=I3 with 0<lambda<1, the whitened pair admits T=e1e1^T+q e*e*^T, I-T=e0e0^T+(1-q)e*e*^T, q in (0,1), with exact common line and d1=q(v.e0)^2, d2=(1-q)(v.e1)^2.

If the two rank-two banks have least positive eigenvalues at least 1/3 and the grouped exits fail as d1<m/4,d2<m/4, then (v.e*)^2>1/4. Hence either lambda>3/4 and residual longitudinal variance is <1/4, or lambda<=3/4 and the actual bank-plane common line has squared cosine >1/16 with v.

In the same exact-rank-three 1+2+2 source-bank chamber, lambda=1 implies ||p_Q||_infinity<148 for arbitrary independent cap-one inputs. The |v^TMv|<=1/2 branch uses fleet04/B20 r4 at <105.463; the complementary branch uses the rank-one-bank Schur theorem at <148.
